title: Sol + Jev advisory development profile
purpose: New sessions default to Sol High; the selected parent remains fixed. Bounded writers use Flash High; native delegates use Astra XHigh. No automatic fallback; requested profiles require observed runtime evidence.
editInstructions: Order candidates as suggestions for an undecided parent, not mandatory dispatch or fallbacks. Explicit user model and family selections take precedence.
Keep ids unique and use exact runtime model identifiers.
Use requiresVerifiedRuntimeAvailability when a model must be observed before selection.
New or unproven mappings stay provisional until runtime evidence upgrades them; config never claims a runtime-resolved model.
Run pnpm roster:check after every edit. A malformed roster fails closed.
For Codex, fast is the priority service tier; it is not a different model id.
Deterministic file search, CLI execution and evidence collection do not require a model worker.
In the SWE-2 experiment all descendants remain SWE; report unavailable capabilities without silently changing family.
The model-route CLI computes a proposal only; when used, supply a roster compatible with the chosen session and lane family before asking it for suggestions. It never dispatches.

routes.label: Pensar, decidir e integrar
does: integrar y dar el veredicto final
routes.when: Las sesiones nuevas usan Sol High. El modelo elegido al iniciar conserva la orquestacion y decide la delegacion.

routes.label: Buscar, crear, editar y probar rapido
routes.when: Escritura acotada con Flash High y ownership exclusivo; el parent resuelve el contrato y verifica el resultado. No hay sustitucion automatica si el proveedor no esta disponible.

candidates.independenceBoundary: exact bounded packet and exclusive ownership; no native fallback
